description: How IntentumDiff parses source into semantic trees — the Wasm parser-plugin architecture, the WIT contract, and how to add or fix a language. Use this whenever you work on a parser crate (`crates/<lang>-parser/`), add support for a new language, debug a parse error / fallback / wrong node types, touch the WIT plugin interface, or need to know why a language behaves the way it does at the tree level. It covers the five plugin worlds, `ParserMode::FullParse`, the CST→SemanticNode mapping, `detect-language`/`example` exports, the shipped-example contract, the Wasm sandbox/fuel model, and the build. Read intentumdiff-architecture for the boundary and intentumdiff-build for compiling; the per-language *diff tuning* above the parser is intentumdiff-language-profiles; the certified native path lives in the Rust core.
